name: Hearth Keeper (Example)
author: voodoo573
description: EXAMPLE ITEM. You know how to make any camp feel like home. Your companions rest better when you set up the fire and cook the meal.
summary: Example feat: better short rests for the whole party.

data.name: Hearth Keeper (Example)
data.desc: When you and your allies finish a short rest at a camp you set up, each ally who spends one or more Hit Dice regains extra hit points equal to your proficiency bonus. You also gain proficiency with cook's utensils.
